game.title: Stellar Blade
game.blurb: Action-adventure game in which the heroine Eve fights unknown enemies on a ruined future Earth, from SHIFT UP, released 2024-04-26. RAWG average playtime: 22 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes.

chapters.title: The Main Story
chapters.summary: Eve's mission on the ruined Earth and the foes she meets. Spoiler-guarded; most achievements here are hidden.

chapters.title: Exploration and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Camps, cans, Nano Suits, Data Bank entries, fishing, boxes and Naytiba research.

chapters.title: Upgrades and Skills
chapters.summary: Maxing Exospines, the Blood Edge, the Rechargeable Tumbler, HP and Beta Energy, and learning every skill.

chapters.title: Combat
chapters.summary: Perfect dodges and parries, executions, Beta, Burst and ranged kills.

chapters.title: New Game + and Full Completion
chapters.summary: Finishing New Game +, learning every skill there, and every main-game achievement.

notes: Backlog game, picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year (docs/PLAN.md section 2 ordering). RAWG's entry for this game uses the slug "project-eve-tba" (id 476122, matching the expected slug); its description still calls it Project Eve. StrategyWiki has no page under "Stellar Blade". stellarblade.fandom.com answers the API, with about 88 linked pages, including one page per achievement (for example "Abaddon (trophy)" and "Raven (trophy)"), "New Game +", "Endings", "Stellar Blade x NieR:Automata" and "Stellar Blade x Goddess of Victory: NIKKE"; names only were looked at, nothing copied. The Steam app used is 3489700 ("Stellar Blade™"). 21 of 45 Steam achievements are hidden, with no descriptions; they sit in the main story chapter as a placeholder. Fandom gives many of them a "(trophy)" page next to a page of the same name without it (for example "Abaddon"), which suggests they are named after foes, but the data does not say so. "EVE Protocol" covers "all achievements in the main game", which suggests other content exists, but no achievement names it.
